title: Compare properties — structuredContent
description: The `structuredContent` of the `compare_properties` MCP tool: 2 to 4 properties side by side for one stay, for the T-06 inline card row (Figma MVP `D_InLine_Light_T-06` 1630:46992 with two cards, 1630:47021 with three; mobile Set 2 581:46963). Fields are designed from PRD T-06 §6, keeping what the MVP card shows. The MVP design has no recommendation block, reason lines or RECOMMENDED chip, so PRD's backend scoring fields are left out (README, decision 1); the model writes its recommendation in the reply, from this data. 0.1.0, provisional (2026-10-27).

imagePath.description: An upstream image path (or absolute URL), resolved by the widget against `meta.asset_base_url`.

property_code.description: PRD `propertyCode`. One of the input's `propertyCodes`. T-04's `propertyCode` for "See room and rates".

property_name.description: PRD `propertyName`, in English as T-01 to T-04. The card title on the hero's brand panel.

brand_code.description: The upstream `brand` slug, as T-01 to T-04 (PRD `brandlogo` is not used: the widget owns the logos). Picks the card's brand panel colour (Figma: Ascott brown, Oakwood blue).

banner_image_url.description: PRD hero image ← upstream `bannerImageMobile`. The card's photo. Optional: without it the card shows a placeholder (EC-09).

location_label.description: PRD "card location line" (backend-composed from city and area), e.g. "Raffles Place, Singapore". Optional; not drawn in the MVP card, kept for the model and the image's alt text.

average_ratings.description: PRD `averageRatings` ← v1/propertyreviews. The "Reviews" row's score and 5-dot visual. Optional with `total_number_of_reviews`: both or neither; the row says the score is unavailable without them (EC-10).

amenity_highlights.description: PRD "Amenity highlight chips" ← upstream `facilityGroup → facilities[]` (`imagePath`, `description`), the same item shape as T-01 `amenities`. At most 6, in the order to show them: MuleSoft picks the highlights (pool, gym, spa, business centre…). The widget shows as many as fit. Optional; empty or absent shows the row as unavailable (EC-10).

imagePath.description: Upstream icon path, e.g. "/content/dam/tal/icons/icon-pool.svg": the widget's icon key, never loaded (as T-01).

description.description: The chip's label, verbatim, e.g. "Swimming pool".

nearby.description: ADDED, not in PRD T-06 §6: the MVP card's "What's nearby?" chips. The same points of interest as T-01 `nearby` (PRD OQ-02: POI API pending), nearest first. The widget shows the first few and "+N" for the rest. Optional.

icon_code.description: An emoji, rendered verbatim before the label (as T-01 `icon_code`).

distance_minutes.description: Walk time in whole minutes, as T-01. Optional; not drawn today, for the model.

availability_status.description: As T-01 `pricing.availability_status`: "on_request" when the property has no rate for the stay (ER-08 / EC-06); the card then shows "Available on request" and, when sent, the next available date instead of a price.

per_night_rate.description: PRD `perNightRatePrefCurr`: the starting per-night rate for the stay in `meta.currency` (converted by upstream, EC-07). The card's "from 175 SGD / Night". Required when `availability_status` is "available". PRD's `strikethroughRate` is left out: the MVP card has no strikethrough price.

next_available_date.description: With "on_request" only: the next date with a rate (ER-08). Optional.

is_asr_participating.description: PRD `isASR` ("Participating in ASR", source to be confirmed) ← upstream `asrParticipating` (T-01's `asr_participating`). False shows the card's grey "This property does not participate in the ASR programme. Loyalty benefits are not applicable." banner.

earn_asr_points.description: ADDED (user, 2026-10-27; not in PRD §6): the ASR points the property's cheapest bookable rate earns for the whole stay, e.g. upstream `earnASRpoints` of that rate. The gold "Earn up to {points} Pts for this stay!" banner. Optional: with `is_asr_participating` true and no value, the card shows no banner.

meta.description: PRD §6 `meta`: the stay that was compared, after server defaults, once per response. The values the comparison used: "See room and rates" passes them to T-04.

total_results.description: The number of properties compared: the length of `properties`.

location_query.description: PRD meta example "Comparing 3 properties in Central Singapore": the area the compared properties share, when they share one. Optional; for the model.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of every price in the response (AC-07).

childAges.description: The input's `childAges` echoed (as T-01 1.2.0). Sent whenever the input had it.

asset_base_url.description: As T-01 to T-04: the origin relative image paths resolve against; default https://www.discoverasr.com.

properties.description: The compared properties, in the order of the input's `propertyCodes`, without the ones not found. Always 2 to 4: when fewer than two are found, the server answers `isError` instead (EC-04), naming the codes it could not find.

excluded.description: Requested properties left out because the code matched no Ascott property (ER-04, ER-06, EC-03), so the model can tell the user, in its reply, and ask for the right name: the widget does not show it. The others are still compared. Optional; absent or empty when every code was found.

reason.description: Why it was left out. Only "not_found" today: no Ascott property has the code. T-06 takes no filters (README decision 7), so nothing else removes a property; the enum leaves room for more reasons later.
